game_updates.title: New Pacify Update: Voices in Darkness (Part 1 of 2)
game_updates.contents: Hello everyone,I spent over a year and a half porting Pacify to consoles, much longer than I expected, but it is finally done. After finishing the final console port (last October), I started building a new game. I was creating a proximity voice chat system for that game, and as I was working on it, I decided it would be great for Pacify. So, I shifted focus and added it to Pacify. It came out great. It is easy to use and has fun voice effects based on the environment and certain situations. I had fun testing it, and it gave me some great ideas for new monsters. And now, I am working on a new map update for Pacify.Today, I'm releasing the first part of this update that includes the proximity voice chat, special voice sound effects, graphic upgrades, plus many bug fixes.I'll be fixing any b...

game_updates.title: New Terraria State of the Game promises fixes for its most frustrating combat problems
game_updates.contents: A new Terraria State of the Game update is here, and developer Re-Logic is finally tackling some of the long-term combat frustrations that have been the bane of the sandbox game for many years. Head of Business Strategy Ted 'Loki' Murphy comments that the Terraria 1.4.5 launch feels like "just yesterday," but says the team has been "head-down working away on post-launch support." With balancing at the center of the next Terraria patch, he believes this next overhaul won't be the last, but hopes that crossplay can move up the priority list soon. game_updates.title: PUBG Global Series Circuit 2 is about to drop!
game_updates.contents: A little over a month after Circuit 1's unpredictable three weeks, the 24 teams are back in Seoul. The PUBG Global Series returns with its second circuit — PGS 4-6 — kicking off May 20.Circuit 2 isn't a reset. The PGS Points earned in Circuit 1 carry directly into the standings, and the final results here decide who qualifies for the Esports World Cup (EWC). game_updates.title: When is the next PUBG update?
game_updates.contents: When is the next PUBG update? There are very few battle royale games, or any games for that matter, that have a history like PUBG. The first BR that truly broke out, it almost single-handedly created an entirely new genre, and it's hard to think about the gaming landscape without the shooter-with-the-ever-closing-circle now. If you haven't played PUBG for a while, logging on might give you a bit of a fright. Menus look completely different, events are constant, but thankfully, the actual game remains more or less the same. There are new weapons and PUBG maps, of course, but it's all about avoiding the zone and putting your enemies to the sword. Read the full story on PCGamesN: When is the next PUBG update?
